from __future__ import print_function
import json, time
import tensorflow as tf
target = 'zrpc://tcp://127.0.0.1:5501'
marker = 'SALUS_CLIENT_RESULT'
steps = 24
start = time.time()
with tf.Graph().as_default():
    with tf.device('/device:GPU:0'):
        x = tf.ones([256, 256], dtype=tf.float32)
        y = tf.matmul(x, x)
        z = tf.reduce_sum(y)
    sess = tf.Session(target=target) if target else tf.Session()
    with sess:
        sess.run(z)
        total = 0.0
        for _ in range(steps):
            total += float(sess.run(z))
wall = time.time() - start
print(marker, json.dumps({'ok': True, 'steps': steps, 'wall_s': wall, 'checksum': total}))
